items.title: Amazon’s data centers used 2.5 billion gallons of water last year
items.description: Just after Seattle enacted a one-year data center moratorium that some of Amazon's own employees pushed for, Amazon shared how much water its data centers use, reportedly for the first time. With concerns about water consumption and energy use a focus of new AI data center construction debates, Amaz
items.tldr: Amazonのデータセンターは昨年、25億ガロンの水を使用したことを発表し、これは同社の従業員が推進したシアトルのデータセンター一時停止令の直後に行われた。新たなAIデータセンター建設に関する議論では、水消費とエネルギー使用が重要な焦点となっている。

items.title: Deezer’s new tool can identify AI music from Spotify, Apple Music, and others
items.description: Deezer introduced a tool that scans playlists from Spotify, Apple Music, and other platforms to identify AI music.

items.title: Stop Returning Flat Text from a PDF: The Relational Shape RAG Needs

items.description: Pool's new app automatically sorts screenshots into personalized collections, tracks down the original links behind saved content, and helps you rediscover products, recipes, travel ideas, and other things you meant to revisit.

items.title: DoorDash’s new AI chatbot lets you order with prompts and photos
items.description: The new chatbot, called Ask DoorDash, allows users to search the app for what they're looking for in their own words instead of having to scroll through restaurants and stores to build a cart.

items.tldr: Anthropicは、新しいAIモデルClaude Fable 5に隠れたガードレールを設けていたことを謝罪し、研究者や競合他社に対する影響を認めた。今後は制限が適用されるタイミングについて、より透明性を持つ方針を示している。
